subject: DI04019011

h.en: 3.1.1 Water to steam:temperature need not keep rising
h.gu: 3.1.1 Waterથી Steam:Temperature સતત વધે જરૂરી નહિ

body.en:
Start with the situation

At a fixed pressure, heating water first raises its temperature, then changes liquid to vapour at saturation temperature, and finally superheats the vapour.

Definition / principle

Saturated liquid is at the onset of vaporisation; wet steam is a saturated liquid–vapour mixture; dry saturated steam has no liquid fraction; superheated steam is above saturation temperature at that pressure.

Understand why

Latent energy changes phase without increasing temperature during ideal constant-pressure equilibrium vaporisation. Saturation pressure and temperature are linked.

Application / illustration

Process heating uses condensation latent heat; superheat can help limit moisture during turbine expansion.

Common mistake / conditions

At subcritical saturation, p andT alone do not determine dryness fraction; one more independent mixture property is needed.

Is dryness a vapour-volume fraction?

No. It is vapour mass divided by total mixture mass.
body.gu:
પરિસ્થિતિથી શરૂઆત

Fixed pressureમાં water ગરમ કરીએ તો પહેલાં temperature વધે,પછી saturation temperature પર liquid vapour બને,પછી vapour superheat થાય.

Definition / Principle

Saturated liquid vaporisation શરૂ થાય તે state;wet steam saturated liquid–vapour mixture;dry saturatedમાં liquid fraction નથી;superheated તે pressureના saturation temperatureથી ઉપર છે.

કારણ સાથે સમજીએ

Ideal constant-pressure equilibrium vaporisationમાં latent energy phase બદલે,temperature નહિ.Saturation pressure,temperature linked છે.

Application / ઉદાહરણ

Process heatingમાં condensation latent heat વપરાય;superheat turbine expansionમાં moisture મર્યાદિત રાખવામાં મદદ કરે.

Common Mistake / શરતો

Subcritical saturationમાં ફક્ત p,Tથી dryness fraction નક્કી નથી થતો;વધારાની independent mixture property જોઈએ.

Dryness Vapour-volume Fraction છે?

ના.Vapour mass/total mixture mass છે.

body.en:
Definition / principle

Dryness fractionx=mass of vapour/total mixture mass, defined for saturated two-phase equilibrium,0≤x≤1.For propertyy in{v, u, h, s}:y=yf+x(y g−y f)=yf+x yfg.

Understand why

For wet steam:h=hf+xhfg, s=sf+xsfg, v=vf+xvfg. Internal energy can be found fromu=h−pv withp inkPa, v inm³/kg andh, u inkJ/kg.

Common mistake / conditions

Do not assignx>1 to superheated steam; use superheated tables instead. Dryness is a mass fraction, not vapour-volume fraction.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

Saturated two-phase equilibriumમાં dryness fraction x=vapour mass/total mixture mass,0≤x≤1.Property y in{v,u,h,s} માટે y=yf+x(y g−y f)=yf+x yfg.

કારણ સાથે સમજીએ

Wet steamમાં h=hf+xhfg,s=sf+xsfg,v=vf+xvfg.u=h−pvથી internal energy મળે;p kPaમાં,v m³/kgમાં,h,u kJ/kgમાં લો.

Common Mistake / શરતો

Superheated steamને x>1 ન આપો;superheated tables લો.Dryness mass fraction છે,vapour-volume fraction નહિ.

h.en: 3.1.3 P–v, T–s and h–s views of formation

body.en:
Understand why

The saturation dome separates compressed-liquid, wet and superheated regions onP–v andT–s plots. Constant-pressure vaporisation crosses the dome horizontally onP–v and at constant saturation temperature onT–s.

Onh–s(Mollier) coordinates, constant-pressure saturation heating obeysDelta h=Tsat Delta s; its slope is absolute saturation temperature in a consistent unit basis.

Common mistake / conditions

Axes and process labels matter; a generic closed loop is not a steam-formation diagram. Qualitative sketches are not calibrated charts.

Can a separator outlet be assumed dry without evidence?

No. Remaining droplets can require a combined calorimeter method.
body.gu:
કારણ સાથે સમજીએ

P–v,T–sમાં saturation dome compressed-liquid,wet,superheated regions જુદા કરે.Constant-pressure vaporisation P–vમાં horizontal,T–sમાં constant saturation temperature પર dome cross કરે.

h–s(Mollier) coordinatesમાં constant-pressure saturation heating માટે Delta h=Tsat Delta s;slope consistent unitsમાં absolute saturation temperature છે.

Common Mistake / શરતો

Axes,process labels જરૂરી;generic closed loop steam-formation diagram નહિ.Qualitative sketches calibrated charts નથી.

Evidence વગર Separator Outlet Dry માની શકાય?

ના.Bાકી droplets માટે combined calorimeter method જોઈએ.

body.en:
Step-by-step solution

  1. Identify the state from pressure, temperature and phase information; convert pressure to the table absolute unit.
  2. Use saturated pressure/temperature tables for the saturation boundary or mixture; readf, g, fg columns carefully.
  3. Use superheated tables whenT>Tsat at that pressure and compressed-liquid data/qualified approximation belowTsat.
  4. Interpolate only within a suitable interval/method; record table edition, units and interpolation assumptions.

Common mistake / conditions

Never treat gauge pressure as table pressure or confusehf withhfg. The near-critical region needs particular care.
body.gu:
Step-by-step ઉકેલ

  1. Pressure,temperature,phaseથી state ઓળખો;pressureને tableના absolute unitમાં ફેરવો.
  2. Saturation boundary/mixtureમાં saturated pressure/temperature tables લો;f,g,fg columns ધ્યાનથી વાંચો.
  3. તે pressure પર T>Tsat હોય તો superheated tables,નીચે compressed-liquid data/qualified approximation લો.
  4. યોગ્ય interval/methodમાં જ interpolate કરો;table edition,units,assumptions નોંધો.

Common Mistake / શરતો

Gauge pressureને table pressure ન માનો,hfને hfg સાથે ન ભેળવો.Near-critical regionમાં ખાસ કાળજી જોઈએ.

body.en:
Given and model

Illustrative supplied saturation data at one pressure:hf640kJ/kg, hfg2100kJ/kg, vf.0011m³/kg, vg.37m³/kg; mixturex.9.

Step-by-step solution

  1. h=640+.9×2100=2530kJ/kg
  2. v=.0011+.9(.37−.0011)=.33311m³/kg
  3. If a second mixture at the same pressure has h2320kJ/kg:x=(2320−640)/2100=.8

Common mistake / conditions

These values are explicitly given teaching data, not a claimed exact steam-table row; use the actual table for a real state.
body.gu:
આપેલી માહિતી અને Model

એક pressureના illustrative supplied saturation data:hf640kJ/kg,hfg2100kJ/kg,vf.0011m³/kg,vg.37m³/kg;mixture x.9.

Step-by-step ઉકેલ

  1. h=640+.9×2100=2530kJ/kg
  2. v=.0011+.9(.37−.0011)=.33311m³/kg
  3. If a second mixture at the same pressure hash2320kJ/kg:x=(2320−640)/2100=.8

Common Mistake / શરતો

આ સ્પષ્ટ given teaching data છે,exact steam-table rowનો દાવો નહિ;real state માટે actual table લો.

h.en: 3.1.6 Mollier chart:read a state, not a guess

body.en:
Step-by-step solution

  1. Locate pressure/temperature or pressure/dryness lines and find their intersection in the correct region.
  2. Readh ands on the chart axes; follow the specified process line, not a nearby convenient grid line.
  3. For an ideal isentropic turbine expansion, follow constant s to the outlet pressure; for ideal throttling follow constant h.
  4. State chart resolution and use tables/software for precision beyond a readable chart.

Common mistake / conditions

A vertical line onh–s means constant s, not constant temperature; the axes determine meaning.
body.gu:
Step-by-step ઉકેલ

  1. Pressure/temperature કે pressure/dryness linesનો correct regionમાં intersection શોધો.
  2. Chart axes પરથી h,s વાંચો;specified process line લો,નજીકની convenient grid line નહિ.
  3. Ideal isentropic turbine expansionમાં constant sથી outlet pressure સુધી જાઓ;ideal throttlingમાં constant h લો.
  4. Chart resolution જણાવો;readable chartથી વધુ precision માટે tables/software લો.

Common Mistake / શરતો

h–s પર vertical line constant s છે,constant temperature નહિ;axes અર્થ નક્કી કરે.

title.gu: 3.2 Dryness માપો:Mass અને Energy બન્ને જુઓ

body.en:
Definition / principle

A measured steam sample condenses in known water; an energy balance estimates inlet mixture enthalpy/dryness.

Construction:part and purpose

An insulated barrel contains known initial water mass.

A sampling/admission tube leads steam into the water.

Thermometer and mixing arrangement estimate uniform temperatures.

Mass measurement and barrel water-equivalent/heat-capacity data support the balance.

Working:flow and reason

Record initial water mass, temperature and apparatus heat capacity under the approved supervised method.

Admit a representative steam sample and ensure condensation within the stated assumptions.

Measure final mixed temperature and collected steam mass.

Balance steam enthalpy loss with water/barrel heat gain and account for any assessed losses.

Common mistake / conditions

Heat loss, incomplete condensation, poor sampling and temperature nonuniformity cause error. Hot steam sampling requires rated safe apparatus and trained supervision.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

Measured steam sample known waterમાં condense થાય;energy balanceથી inlet mixture enthalpy/drynessનો અંદાજ મળે.

Construction:ભાગ અને કામ

Insulated barrelમાં known initial water mass હોય.

Sampling/admission tube steamને waterમાં લાવે.

Thermometer,mixing arrangement uniform temperaturesનો અંદાજ આપે.

Mass measurement,barrel water-equivalent/heat-capacity data balanceને ટેકો આપે.

Working:Flow અને કારણ

Approved supervised methodમાં initial water mass,temperature,apparatus heat capacity નોંધો.

Representative steam sample લઈ stated assumptionsમાં condensation કરો.

Final mixed temperature,collected steam mass માપો.

Steam enthalpy lossને water/barrel heat gain સાથે balance કરી assessed losses લો.

Common Mistake / શરતો

Heat loss,incomplete condensation,poor sampling,temperature nonuniformity errors આપે.Hot steam samplingમાં rated safe apparatus,trained supervision જોઈએ.

body.en:
Given and model

Initial water5kg at20°C, condensed steam.5kg, final70°C; ignore barrel heat capacity/losses, cp water4.18kJ/kgK; inlet saturationhf500, hfg2200kJ/kg.

Step-by-step solution

  1. Energy:.5[h in−4.18(70)]=5×4.18(70−20)
  2. h in=2382.6kJ/kg
  3. x=(2382.6−500)/2200=.855727

Common mistake / conditions

Final condensed steam remains as water at70°C; its final enthalpy must be included rather than treating all its inlet enthalpy as available heat.
body.gu:
આપેલી માહિતી અને Model

Initial water5kg20°C,condensed steam.5kg,final70°C;barrel heat capacity/losses અવગણો,water cp4.18kJ/kgK;inlet saturation hf500,hfg2200kJ/kg.

Step-by-step ઉકેલ

  1. Energy:.5[h in−4.18(70)]=5×4.18(70−20)
  2. h in=2382.6kJ/kg
  3. x=(2382.6−500)/2200=.855727

Common Mistake / શરતો

Condensed steam અંતે70°C water તરીકે રહે;તેનું final enthalpy ઉમેરવું પડે,બધું inlet enthalpy available heat ન માનો.

body.en:
Definition / principle

A separator removes liquid droplets by inertial flow changes; collected liquid and outgoing steam masses give an approximate inlet dryness if separation is complete.

Construction:part and purpose

A vessel/baffles change sample direction or velocity.

A liquid collection/drain measures separated water.

An outlet passes remaining vapour plus any unseparated moisture.

A downstream condenser/mass measurement estimates outgoing sample mass.

Working:flow and reason

Pass a representative sample through the separator.

Droplets fail to follow rapid direction changes and collect.

Measure separated waterms and remaining samplemt.

With a dry outlet assumption, x=mt/(ms+mt); otherwise this overestimates true dryness.

Common mistake / conditions

The outlet is not guaranteed completely dry; combined separating/throttling measurement improves the information.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

Separator inertial flow changesથી droplets કાઢે;collected liquid,outgoing steam massesથી complete separation માનીએ તો inlet drynessનો અંદાજ મળે.

Construction:ભાગ અને કામ

Vessel/baffles sampleની direction/velocity બદલે.

Liquid collection/drain separated water માપે.

Outlet vapour સાથે unseparated moisture પસાર કરે.

Downstream condenser/mass measurement outgoing mass આપે.

Working:Flow અને કારણ

Representative sample separatorમાંથી લો.

Droplets ઝડપી direction changes ન અનુસરી collect થાય.

Separated water ms,remaining sample mt માપો.

Dry outlet assumptionમાં x=mt/(ms+mt);નહિ તો true dryness વધારે અંદાજાય.

Common Mistake / શરતો

Outlet completely dry હોવાની guarantee નહિ;combined separating/throttlingથી વધુ માહિતી મળે.

body.en:
Definition / principle

A separator removes bulk liquid; the remaining sample throttles to a lower pressure and must become superheated for the simple enthalpy method.

Construction:part and purpose

A first separator measures removed liquidms.

A throttle valve/orifice produces pressure reduction.

Outlet pressure/temperature instruments establish the downstream state.

A condenser measures throttled sample massmt; inlet pressure fixes saturatedhf, hfg.

Working:flow and reason

Separate and measure collected liquid without assuming all moisture was removed.

Throttle under a steady, approximately adiabatic, no-shaft-work model with negligible kinetic change:hbefore≈hafter.

Confirm superheat at the measured outlet pressure and readhafter from a table.

Find separator-outlet drynessxt=(hafter−hf)/hfg.

Original drynessx=mt xt/(ms+mt); retain mass and heat-loss assumptions.

Common mistake / conditions

If the throttled outlet is still wet, p andT alone cannot establish its enthalpy/dryness; do not apply the superheated method anyway.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

Separator bulk liquid કાઢે;remaining sample lower pressure પર throttle થાય અને simple enthalpy method માટે superheated બનવું જોઈએ.

Construction:ભાગ અને કામ

First separator removed liquid ms માપે.

Throttle valve/orifice pressure reduction આપે.

Outlet pressure/temperature instruments downstream state આપે.

Condenser throttled mass mt માપે;inlet pressure saturated hf,hfg આપે.

Working:Flow અને કારણ

Collected liquid અલગ/માપો,બધું moisture નીકળ્યું એમ ન માનો.

Steady,approximately adiabatic,no-shaft-work,negligible kinetic changeમાં throttle કરો:hbefore≈hafter.

Measured outlet pressure પર superheat confirm કરી tableથી hafter લો.

Separator-outlet dryness xt=(hafter−hf)/hfg શોધો.

Original dryness x=mt xt/(ms+mt);mass,heat-loss assumptions રાખો.

Common Mistake / શરતો

Throttled outlet હજી wet હોય તો p,Tથી એકલું enthalpy/dryness નહિ મળે;superheated method જબરદસ્તી ન લો.

body.en:
Given and model

ms.1kg, mt1.9kg; upstream saturatedhf600, hfg2100kJ/kg; measured superheated outlet giveshafter2658kJ/kg.

Step-by-step solution

  1. xt=(2658−600)/2100=.98
  2. Originalx=(1.9×.98)/(1.9+.1)=.931=93.1%

Common mistake / conditions

Usingmt/(ms+mt)=.95 alone assumes dry separator discharge and misses its remaining2% liquid mass fraction.
body.gu:
આપેલી માહિતી અને Model

ms.1kg,mt1.9kg;upstream saturated hf600,hfg2100kJ/kg;measured superheated outletથી hafter2658kJ/kg.

Step-by-step ઉકેલ

  1. xt=(2658−600)/2100=.98
  2. Originalx=(1.9×.98)/(1.9+.1)=.931=93.1%

Common Mistake / શરતો

ફક્ત mt/(ms+mt)=.95 લેવાથી dry separator discharge માનીએ અને બાકી2% liquid fraction ચૂકી જઈએ.

body.en:
Definition / principle

Known electrical heat input raises a steam sample to a known outlet state, allowing an enthalpy balance for inlet dryness.

Construction:part and purpose

An insulated flow chamber contains an electric heater.

Electrical measurement supplies actual heater input power.

Pressure/temperature instruments identify the outlet state.

Steam-flow measurement and heat-loss assessment complete the energy balance.

Working:flow and reason

Establish steady representative flow with rated supervised equipment.

Measure electrical power, mass flow and relevant losses.

Ensure the outlet state is independently known, often superheated.

Calculateh in=h out−(P electric−Qloss)/mdot, thenx=(h in−hf)/hfg.

Common mistake / conditions

Example withh out2800kJ/kg, net heat300kJ/kg, hf600, hfg2100 givesh in2500 andx.904762.Electrical energy is not automatically all transferred to steam.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

Known electrical heat input sampleને known outlet state સુધી લાવે;enthalpy balanceથી inlet dryness મળે.

Construction:ભાગ અને કામ

Insulated flow chamberમાં electric heater હોય.

Electrical measurement actual heater power આપે.

Pressure/temperature instruments outlet state ઓળખાવે.

Steam-flow measurement,heat-loss assessment energy balance પૂરો કરે.

Working:Flow અને કારણ

Rated supervised equipmentથી steady representative flow લો.

Electrical power,mass flow,relevant losses માપો.

Outlet state independently known રાખો,ઘણીવાર superheated.

h in=h out−(P electric−Qloss)/mdot ગણો,પછી x=(h in−hf)/hfg.

Common Mistake / શરતો

h out2800kJ/kg,net heat300kJ/kg,hf600,hfg2100માં h in2500,x.904762 મળે.Electrical energy આપમેળે બધી steamમાં જતી નથી.

body.en:
Write a strong exam answer

  1. Identify state/reference pressure→select correct table/chart→list supplied properties→apply mixture/energy relation→check0≤x≤1 only where a mixture exists.
  2. Calorimeter answer:label every stream and collection mass, show sampling and state measurements, write mass+energy balances, then limitations—not just an apparatus sketch.
Does saturation temperature alone reveal whether steam is wet or dry?

No. Both saturated liquid/vapour mixtures and dry saturated vapour can sharep, T.
body.gu:
Exam Answer મજબૂત ગોઠવીએ

  1. State/reference pressure→correct table/chart→supplied properties→mixture/energy relation→mixture હોય ત્યાં જ0≤x≤1 check.
  2. Calorimeter answerમાં દરેક stream,collection mass label કરો,sampling/state measurements બતાવો,mass+energy balances લખો,પછી limitations—ફક્ત sketch નહિ.
Saturation Temperatureથી જ Steam Wet કે Dry જાણી શકાય?

ના.Saturated mixtures,dry saturated vapourનું p,T same હોઈ શકે.
